proposal.description_medium: On October 10, 2025, Melania Trump said eight children displaced by the Russia-Ukraine war had been reunited with family members after months of back-channel contacts with Russia. The Associated Press reported that the children included three displaced to Russia by front-line fighting and five separated from relatives across borders. The announcement was attributed to the first lady; the article did not independently identify the children or detail each return. The entry should preserve that attribution and avoid implying that all eight were Ukrainian children.
